title: 第31课 · 我把行李忘在车上了
subtitle: Lesson 31 — 我把行李忘在车上了 · I left my luggage in the car

Wǒ bǎ xíngli wàng zài chē shang le.
items.en: I left my luggage in the car.

items.py: Qǐng bǎ chuānghu dǎkāi.

items.zh: 你把书放在桌子上了吗？
items.py: Nǐ bǎ shū fàng zài zhuōzi shang le ma?
items.en: Did you put the book on the table?

items.py: Qǐng bǎ mén guān shang.
Wǒ bǎ zuòyè zuò wán le.
Tā bǎ bēizi dǎ suì le.

items.zh: 大卫：糟糕！我把行李忘在出租车上了。
items.py: Dàwèi: Zāogāo! Wǒ bǎ xíngli wàng zài chūzū chē shang le.
items.en: David: Oh no! I left my luggage in the taxi.

items.zh: 刘京：你记得出租车的号码吗？
items.py: Liú Jīng: Nǐ jìde chūzū chē de hàomǎ ma?
items.en: Liu Jing: Do you remember the taxi number?

items.py: Dàwèi: Bú jìde le. Zěnme bàn?
items.en: David: I don't remember. What should I do?

items.py: Liú Jīng: Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu fāpiào?
items.en: Liu Jing: Do you have a receipt?

items.py: Dàwèi: Yǒu! Fāpiào shang yǒu hàomǎ.
items.en: David: Yes! The receipt has the number.

items.zh: 刘京：那我帮你打电话问问。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Nà wǒ bāng nǐ dǎ diànhuà wènwen.
items.en: Liu Jing: Then I'll call and ask for you.

items.zh: 张老师：请把书打开，翻到第三十一课。
items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Qǐng bǎ shū dǎkāi, fān dào dì sānshíyī kè.
items.en: Teacher Zhang: Please open your book to Lesson 31.

items.zh: 张老师：大卫，请把窗户打开，太热了。
items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Dàwèi, qǐng bǎ chuānghu dǎkāi, tài rè le.
items.en: Teacher Zhang: David, please open the window, it's too hot.

items.py: Dàwèi: Hǎo de.

items.zh: 张老师：下课了。请把作业交给我。
items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Xià kè le. Qǐng bǎ zuòyè jiāo gěi wǒ.
items.en: Teacher Zhang: Class is over. Please hand in your homework.

items.zh: 玛丽：老师，我把作业忘在宿舍了。
items.py: Mǎlì: Lǎoshī, wǒ bǎ zuòyè wàng zài sùshè le.
items.en: Mary: Teacher, I left my homework in the dorm.

items.zh: 张老师：那请你明天把作业带来。
items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Nà qǐng nǐ míngtiān bǎ zuòyè dài lái.
items.en: Teacher Zhang: Then please bring it tomorrow.

items.py: Qǐng bǎ mén guān shang.
items.en: 把 + object + verb + result: Close the door.

items.py: Wǒ bǎ shū fàng zài zhuōzi shang le.
items.en: I put the book on the table.

items.py: Tā bǎ kāfēi hē wán le.
Qǐng bǎ míngzi xiě zài zhèr.
Tā bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo gānjìng le.
Bù néng shuō: Tā bǎ shū kàn le. ✗
items.en: WRONG: 把 needs a result/direction, not bare 了.

items.zh: 请把窗户打开。→ 请把门打开。
items.py: Qǐng bǎ chuānghu dǎkāi. → Qǐng bǎ mén dǎkāi.
items.en: Open the window. → Open the door.

items.py: Qǐng bǎ dēng guān shang.
Qǐng bǎ diànshì guān shang.
Wǒ bǎ zuòyè zuò wán le.
Tā bǎ fàn chī wán le.
Qǐng bǎ zhège zì xiě yī biàn.
